task: Predict PIK3CA mutation status in breast cancer. Classes: wildtype vs mutant. On H&E, subtle correlates may include more differentiated hormone receptor-like morphology, lower nuclear grade, and less extreme pleomorphism in mutant tumors compared with more overtly aggressive alternatives.

classes.0: PIK3CA wildtype tumor lacking distinctive mutation-associated morphology and more often showing non-specific invasive breast carcinoma features.
classes.1: PIK3CA mutant tumor with relatively differentiated morphology, often lower grade appearance, and less marked pleomorphism.
